Container.Overview:
Image keeper for Forgejo Runner using the official Gitea runner images.
This container must stay stopped: it only exists so the image is not shown as an orphan and can be updated from the Unraid UI.
Do NOT start it and do NOT enable Autostart.
NOTE: ubuntu-latest currently points to ubuntu-24.04, see the repository README for the current mapping.
Container.Requires:
Select the same tag that your runner label uses, for example:
`ubuntu-latest:docker://docker.gitea.com/runner-images:ubuntu-latest`.
